scenes.headline: 4 Rivers keeps growing
scenes.body: Since you last saw it, the course picked up a community, new calculators, and a Spanish version. Here is a quick look.

scenes.headline: Now available in Spanish
scenes.body: Switch from the A menu. Lessons, quizzes, Scripture, and tools follow your choice, and you can make the text larger too.

scenes.headline: Build a real monthly budget
scenes.body: List income, needs, discretionary spending, saving, investing, and giving, and see where every dollar goes.

scenes.headline: See what time does to your money
scenes.body: Compare cash, a high yield savings account, and stocks and bonds over as many years as you like.

scenes.headline: Print your stewardship plan
scenes.body: Export a one page PDF with your name, the four rivers, and every line of your budget.

scenes.headline: A glossary for every money term
scenes.body: Fifty short definitions you can search, so no word gets in the way of the idea.

scenes.headline: Join a group with a four digit code
scenes.body: Enter the code your leader shares, or scan their QR code, and you are in.

scenes.headline: Share a code or a QR to invite
scenes.body: Approved leaders create a group, then hand out a four digit code or a QR that opens the join page.

scenes.headline: Talk with people you know by name
scenes.body: Group chat shows each person's picture and preferred name, so it feels like a real conversation.

scenes.headline: A prayer wall on a blackboard
scenes.body: Requests are pinned like notes written in pencil. Tap the drop when you pray, and mark them answered later.

scenes.headline: Pick a picture or a sketch
scenes.body: Upload a photo or choose from 23 hand drawn symbols like the lion, lamb, dove, and lamp. Set your preferred name too.

scenes.headline: Know when someone joins or finishes
scenes.body: A bell tells you when a new member arrives or a classmate passes the final exam.

scenes.headline: Spread any passage across the calendar
scenes.body: Choose passages and dates, read books one after another or together, and keep chapters whole or split them at natural breaks.

scenes.headline: Check in on today's reading
scenes.body: Tick off each day and see everyone's progress in one row, with a check for every reading done.

scenes.headline: Find any verse in the Bible
scenes.body: Look up a reference or a word. The KJV is built in, with the ESV and NLT through their own services.

scenes.headline: Co-leaders help run the group
scenes.body: A leader can name co-leaders to help with verses, plans, and moderation, while only the admin creates new leaders.

scenes.headline: Free for every young adult
scenes.body: Install it on your phone like an app. Start today at
